notes.title: TFO VR Second Beta Release Finally Available
notes.notes:
The new update is finally here and you can look forward on many new fixes and features including performance optimization, AI improvements, new soundtracks, shader improvements, added new GUI Effects and first test of multiplayer mode!

The fifth release contains:
- Fixed FPS drops
- Fixed Beamsword lacks
- Fixed AI glitches
- Added new soundtracks
- Added extra statistics
- Added final battle results
- Added first online multiplayer mode [Early Alpha]
- Added extra GUI effects

We really appreciate every new support and we are trying to do our best to bring you an incredible experience. We are very sorry for a late that we had. We've finally figured out the server issues and now it's ready for testing. Please if you have any issues in Online Matches, write to the pinned discussion here.

The next release date is not release, because we'd like to fix last and well-known issues and add last promised features to release the game as a full title. We hope you will stay with us and make the game done! We will do the best to make your experience even much better!

- TFO Team.

notes.title: Update Delayed - Server Problems
notes.notes:
TFO VR Second Beta release is delayed. We are having a little server problems. We want to make the first early alpha multiplayer playable and well working. We are very sorry for this issue and we hope you will stay with us! We need your help to improve the game. Thank you for your patience!

The new update will bring you new features such as updated menu, fixed many glitches and the first multiplayer. Actually the official date for the update is not released. We don't know how long the issue will take.

But we have also a great news! The game is in the +30% sale. The sale will be active the whole christmas time. So keep checking and sharing if you do not own the game yet! Thank you!

- Early Alpha testing shot from the Multiplayer scene [Michael & Matt]

notes.title: TFO VR First Beta Release Available
notes.notes:
Welcome to Beta version! It's finally here. The new update contains many new amazing things such as new menu style, new maps, optimized performance, fixed many bugs [Covers logic, AI teleportation...]. This time, we've focused on player's psychology and more realistic environment.

The fourth release contains:
- Fixed FPS drops
- Fixed VR Character drops
- Fixed In-Game Menu
- New Maps
- Updated Menu Style
- Updated Game Style
- Added Statistics
- Optimized Game Performance

We are very glad that you are still with us and following the entire TFO VR development. Thank you for all your support! In the upcoming version [TFO VR Second Beta Release] we would like to implement first multiplayer logic, so you can look forward for the first multiplayer matches!

The next release date is 12/12/2017. It's a magical date and almost the end of the year 2017! That means, we are very close to the full game release. We will do the best to make your experience even much better.

notes.title: TFO VR Third Alpha Release Delayed & Official Date
notes.notes:
We have some technical and in-game problems, so the third release of TFO VR will be delayed. Official Alpha Third release is on 20th September. We are very sorry about that, we are doing the best for even better experience.

The Third Alpha Release will contains following news:

• New Map in Campaign Mode
• New Map in Custom Mode
• New Map in Space Battles - Campaign
• New Map in Space Battles - Custom

We have also fixed many known bugs and issues like movement glitches, unsynced FPS in Space Battles, in game lags and more.

In the upcoming third release you can look forward on a clearly new battlefield map with an amazing experience and unique atmosphere.

Check the shot from one of the upcoming maps

notes.title: TFO Alpha Second Release official date
notes.notes:
The Frontier Outskirts VR is going very well and we've got great news for you. TFO Alpha First Release is currently online and we are very glad that you keep following the latest news of TFO. The game is going to be very interesting now, because next release will bring a lot of amazing features like VR character, space battles and more.

Thank you very much for the reviews and suggestions. We appreciate every comment and feedback. Only community pushes us forward!

Official release date of TFO Alpha Second Release is 1st August 2017.

Upcoming new features:

 VR Character
 Space Battles
 New Movement Modes
 Improved Troops AI
 New Map
 Updated Game Style


• VR Character
You will be finally able to see your whole virtual body. The first type of character will take you to the incredible battle atmosphere.

• Space Battles
The big next feature of the game are space battles. We are very happy to introduce you this great feature. The upcoming version will include first space map called Star Primes and first collection of spaceships with interiors.

• New Movement Modes
New movement modes is very helpful feature, because a lot of people don't like locomotion movement. So we added many more movement modes. Upcoming version will include 3 new movement modes with a lot of settings. Locomotion (you will be able to set up all settings for loco mode), Teleportation (Teleportation speed and many more settings will be available) and Touchpad movement (you will be able to set up settings as you wish as well). We really care of your comfort in the game...

• Improved AI
Soldiers will be able to find their own covers much quicker than before. Accuracy and movement flexibility will be also improved.

• New Map
New map for Ground Mode will be something new for TFO. It's a map of Jungle type. It's called The Forest Occupation. More you will see in the game or on the screenshots.

• Updated Game Style
As the game moves forward, we really want to update game style as much as it's possible. It's more futuristic!

Thank you very much for reading latest news and we hope you will stay with us! Enjoy and thanks again!!!
